items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms the interviewer's statement that Bunny and Jonah were good friends ('Oh, yeah'), but does not describe a personal relationship between himself and Jonah Jones.

ctx.x: -- because here's the factor that I mean. Bunny could -- would come down and you say, sit in, with Jonah, all right. Most guys like Jonah and Bunny are affected, emotionally, by one another.
